content:
harper: quick personal share — two things that made my week: accepted a promotion to Principal Engineer 🎉 and also quietly eloped last Saturday (we kept it very small) 💍. figured id drop it here since youre my people.
ben: WHOA congrats times a million!! principal engineer!!! and eloped?! photos pls 😭🥂
rachel: ecstatic for you!! double celebrations. when are we doing an office thing? small cake? i can coordinate. :party_popper:
ike: major congrats harper. if you want a silly hat and a banner I will volunteer them. also happy to cover any on-call if you need time off.
harper: thanks yall. were planning a tiny reception next month for close friends/family. not big on gifts but if folks want to send cards i made a short link for addresses: https://tinyurl.com/harper-eloped (just a placeholder).
ben: poll: bubbly at the office toast — Champagne 🥂 / Sparkling cider 🥤 / Coffee & donuts ☕🍩 ? react with emoji.
rachel: :wine_glass: (i mean 🍾 but this is slack emoji limit)
ike: :coffee: (but i will drink the bubbly too)
people-ops-bot: Congrats harper! 🎊 People Ops can set up a 30-minute "Harper: Promo + Elopement" office meetup on a Friday afternoon. React with :handshake: if you'd like People Ops to handle snacks & card.
rachel: :handshake:
ben: :thumbsup:
harper: super appreciate this team. also happy to share a tiny photo album later. thanks for being so supportive. <3
